Verify-command taxonomy (1) substring false-positive and (7) unstated prerequisite: the §I1 line range is never determined
findings.finding: AC1's proving command `grep -n "implemented" docs/concurrency.md` is an unanchored substring match. It also matches 'unimplemented', 'not implemented', or any other existing use of the word, so it can pass before the change. It does not assert that the hit is inside §I1 or that it refers to ADR 0106 reclamation.
scenarios: The doc already says 'implemented' somewhere (e.g. another §I paragraph), so the grep is green with no edit made
The new paragraph says 'not yet implemented' and the grep still passes
findings.suggested_fix: Extract the section, then grep it, e.g. `awk '/^#+ .*I1/{f=1;next} /^#+ .*I2/{f=0} f' docs/concurrency.md | grep -E 'ADR 0106.*\*\*implemented\*\*|\*\*implemented\*\*.*ADR 0106'`. Add one `grep -F` per module name (`rebar._store.reclaim_eligibility`, `rebar._commands.reclaim_collapse`, `rebar._commands.reclaim_publish`, `rebar._commands.reclaim_dry_run`, `rebar._store.stale_override`) against the same extract.
